cs.t: I had an original Scribe and while the writing experience was superb, I felt like the software experience was minimal and over the year or so I had it, it didn't really get enhanced any.  My review of it was: It's just like paper, only more expensive. It seemed like if you wanted a large ebook reader  AND  occasional note taking, it's probably great.  For my use, I would have been just as happy with just a spiral notebook, probably happier.  I used it every day for work notes and todos. I sold it on ebay and got an Boox Note Air3, similar cost, and the writing experience is not nearly as good as the Scribe, but it is a much more capable device with many more features in the notebook.  However, I've fallen out of the habit of using it, I think just because the writing experience isn't as good.
